name: Reverent Wielder
source: PFS Guide to Organized Play 6.0 pg. 16
body:
Drawbacks
Reverent Wielder
Source PFS Guide to Organized Play 6.0 pg. 16
Category Faction
Some of the most powerful weapons are priceless and ancient, and you are vigilant in protecting your equipment as much as you protect yourself. You gain a +1 trait bonus to CMD against disarm, steal, and sunder combat maneuvers, and your equipment gains a +1 trait bonus on all saving throws.
